text:
mike: Quick question — our chart crashes during `helm template` when `envFrom` is empty and we try to lookup an external Secret. Error is a nil pointer in the template.

anna: Can you paste the snippet? lookup returns nil if the object doesn't exist so you need to guard it. :eyes:

mike: Here's the relevant part:
```
env:
  - name: FOO
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: {{ .Values.secretName }}
        key: FOO
```
We try to fallback to an external secret via `.Values.externalSecretName` using `lookup` but template crashes when that's not set.

raj: Two fast options:
1) Guard the `lookup` result with `if`/`with`:
```
{{- $ext := lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace .Values.externalSecretName }}
{{- if $ext }}
# use $ext
{{- end }}
```
`lookup` returns nil if not found, so `if $ext` prevents deref.

sasha: Also consider using `default`/coalesce semantics so values override precedence is clear. e.g.
```
name: {{ default .Values.externalSecretName .Values.secretName }}
```
But for `lookup` you still need the `if` guard before using fields like `data`.

mike: Ah got it — my template was doing `{{ $s := lookup ... }}{{ $s.data.foo }}` directly which panicked.
I changed to:
```
{{- $s := lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace .Values.externalSecretName }}
{{- if $s }}
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: {{ $s.metadata.name }}
      key: FOO
{{- else }}
  # fallback to chart-managed secret
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: {{ .Values.secretName | default (include "fullname" .) }}
      key: FOO
{{- end }}
```
`helm template` passes locally now.

anna: Nice — can you also add a unit test in `tests/` (helm-unittest) that covers when `externalSecretName` is empty and when it's present? Catch regressions.

mike: Will add tests + changelog, opening PR and tagging @anna @raj for review. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Lint pipeline triggered for mike/helm-external-secret-fix — chart-lint OK, awaiting tests.

raj: Ping me once PR is up, will do a quick perf check for autoscaler env impact.

mike: Thanks all!
